newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open 0.20 cent higher.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open 0.20 cent higher.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open 0.20 cent a lb firmer on Tuesday, based on market orders at 1018 EDT, dealers said.
The market is expected to correct some of the losses made during the previous session.
Support in July pegged at 72.00 cents, and technical resistance remained at the recent high of 73.90 cents in July.
The weekly spec/hedge report will be delayed until Wednesday, NYCE said.

Monday, the December settled at 74.93 cents a lb, down 1.09 cents. The contract ranged from 76.25 to 74.80 cents. Spot July fell 0.91 cent on the day to 72.24 cents, while the rest of the board finished 0.78 to 1.03 lower.
